Results.ReviewText: I have had many different grills in the past 28 years. I do store them in a garage, so my grills do last many years. I do enjoy to grill once I learn a grills hot spots. My last grill, not a Weber, I never found the perfect spot. I bought my first Weber gas grill. I do own a weber charcoal grill and love it. Back to the gas grill, from the first time i cooked on it, the entire cook surface cooks evenly. The grates are easy to clean. I bought the non-stick grate spray, sold by Weber, and it works amazing. I have cooked about 8 times on the grill in the past 3 weeks. BBQ shrimp on skewers, steaks, and the entire 4th of July hot dogs and hamburgers. I am now a fan of Webers. I went with the 210, and it is plenty big enough for the amount of people I feed every weekend and just my daughter and I during the week.
Results.Title: Easy to grill on with an evenly heated surface.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill at Home Depot and paid for delivery and assembly. It was shoddily put together and the ignition didn't work. I called HD and they said that I would have to return the grill before they would deliver a new one. I had to find someone with a truck to transport it back to the store so I could get a refund. When HD staff was helping me unload the wheels rolled off. Not sure if the grill not working was a manufacturing issue or poor assembly. In any event, I'm a bit wary of the quality of Weber now.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
